from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u078/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    n = h * w
    rare = {v for v, c in counts.items() if c < n * 0.20}
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in rare for v in grid[r])]
    if len(rows) < 2:
        return [[max(counts, key=counts.get)]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in rows}) > 1]
    if len(cols) < 2:
        return [[max(counts, key=counts.get)]]
    # The repeating texture is the default; the colored junctions encode pixels.
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rows for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    default = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            a, b = grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]]
            c, d = grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]
            value = default
            for color in rare:
                if a == b == c == d == color or a == c == color or b == d == color or a == b == color or c == d == color:
                    value = color
                    break
            row.append(value)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
